# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest version on the `main` branch receives security fixes.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public issue for security problems.

Report vulnerabilities privately through GitHub: go to the **Security** tab of
this repository and click **Report a vulnerability**.

You can expect an initial response within 14 days. If the report is confirmed,
a fix will be released as soon as possible and you will be credited in the
release notes unless you ask otherwise.
